meta.title: dsh-qgis-driver
meta.description: Drive a running QGIS (dsh_qgis_driver plugin) from DeepSeek Harness: execute code on the QGIS main thread, submit background tasks, and poll results — locally via registry discovery, or remotely via host + port + Key (configurable from Settings). A QGIS connection-status widget below the composer can be enabled in Settings (off by default).
